central_assessment: The project now has two independently documented cross-period constructional bridges centered on *-ame: (1) stative -ga + -(a)me(+ke) and (2) internal -li + participial/nominalizing -ameke/-ame. Historical tsane-li-ameke is explicitly analyzed in the Steffel material, while modern ani-li-ame is explicitly segmented and the li+ame chain is replicated across multiple lexical families and varieties. This substantially strengthens constructional continuity, but it still does not license a universal -ameke > -ami rule or automatic lexical cognacy.

historical_layers.evidence: *-ame adjectivalizer/nominalizer/participial; late PT stative constructions contain *-ame.
Guadalaxara Pedro norugamek provides a pre-Steffel stative gamek chain.

evidence: Merrill explicitly segments stative -ga~-ja + participial -(a)me + final -ke in historical chains.
Steffel reports frequent omission of final -ke.
Merrill explicitly derives tsane-li-ameke from tsaní 'afirmar' + APPL -e + PASS -li + PTCP -ameke.
Historical passive -li is independently productive before outer suffixes: -li-la and -li-ameke are directly analyzed.
Participial/nominalizing -ame/-me and surface -ami are independently documented.
Munérachi ani-lí-ame is directly segmented; Choguita rihói-li-ame demonstrates PST + PTCP stacking.
The li+ame chain has at least three independently controlled lexical families: newa- 'hacer', me'á- 'matar', ani- 'decir/llamar'.

ga_ame.limits: Do not identify every historical c/k with -ga or modern -ka automatically.

li_ame.historical_second_family_support: tschutschá / tschutschelíla / tschutschelíameke is strongly paradigm-compatible but lacks a separately recovered full parse.
limits: The function of -li is not proven identical across every root and variety.
Historical -li-ameke > modern -li-ame is not formulated as a mechanical sound/morphology rule.
Constructional continuity does not itself prove cognacy of tsaní and ani-.

na_color.limits: Historical -na is a general verbalizer, not demonstrably color-specific at the earlier stage.

historical_tsani_modern_ani.comparative_control: Warihó has consonant-initial say forms ce-/cha-ni, which complicate a single-mechanism initial-loss explanation.

comparative_say_domain.proto_reconstruction_status: No accepted specific Proto-Tarahumaran *tsani/*ani reconstruction was found in the audited primary comparative sources.
active_scenarios: S1 initial affricate loss in Rarámuri
S2 morphological restructuring/reanalysis of an older consonant-initial say construction

claims_supported: The *-ame domain is reconstructible before the documentary period.
Historical and modern Rarámuri both explicitly document stative+participial ga+ame architecture.
Historical and modern Rarámuri both explicitly document internal-li + outer participial/nominalizing -ameke/-ame architecture.
Historical passive -li can receive more than one outer derivational suffix, so tsane-li-ameke is not morphotactically ad hoc.
Modern li+ame is constructionally productive across multiple lexical families; newálime is very unlikely to be an isolated lexicalization.
The tsaní/ani comparison is semantically and morphologically exceptionally strong, while its specific phonological history remains unresolved.
claims_not_supported: Automatic identity of -li function across all roots and varieties.
Automatic cognacy of tsaní and ani-.
A sound law *¢ > Ø based on the tsaní/ani comparison alone.
Resegmentation of historical tsaní as tsa-ni solely from Warihó cha-ni.
Automatic identity of every historical color c/k with stative -ga or modern -ka.

priority_candidates.interpretation: Architecture grades and priority labels describe evidential structure, not final cognacy.

next_phase: Recover or directly audit Guadalaxara 1683 for say/speak roots and applicative paradigms.
Find an independent historical <ts>/<tsch>-initial > modern vowel-initial series, or a Proto-Tarahumaran reconstruction, before promoting the tsaní/ani sound correspondence.
Seek a second explicit historical parse of li+ameke; tschutschelíameke is the leading paradigm candidate.
Find a fourth modern lexical root with directly segmented li+ame to quantify constructional productivity further.
Resolve the exact Western segmentation/function of -li in newálime and me'líame separately.
epistemic_rule: Constructional continuity, morpheme-function identity, sound correspondence, and lexical cognacy are four separate claims. Strengthening one level never automatically promotes the others.
